messages:
incident-bot: Page fired: GPU memory pressure on pool inference-west2 (alert_id: GPM-20250318-004). NVML OOM events rising, 12 nodes > 85% vmem. Dashboards: https://redwood.app/dash/abcd

dmitri: ack — I'm on it, taking node list.

dmitri: running `kubectl get pods -n inference -o wide --field-selector=status.phase=Running | grep west2` to find hot pods

alice: noted big batch run from customer acme-biz around 21:12 UTC, correlates.

carla: can we route traffic to fallback smaller model? If we can spin up small instances quickly that helps.

dmitri: evicting pods on gpu-node-17 to free KV cache: `kubectl drain gpu-node-17 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data` starting now

pagerduty: PagerDuty notification: escalation to SRE Lead in 5m if unacked.

ben: FYI I've bumped Dedicated pool autoscale min by +2 (API request sent), should appear in ~45s.

dmitri: node eviction completed on gpu-node-17, freed 28GB vmem. NVML events decreasing.

alice: metrics show request errors dropped from 14% -> 3% in last 2m. still some 503s for long-tail customers.

carla: any customer impact? opsstatus?

dmitri: Impact: ~3 customers saw increased tail latency; acme-biz had ~60 failed requests over 5m. Notified account team to loop in support.

incident-bot: Auto-remediation: kvcache compaction triggered on pool inference-west2 (run id compaction-20250318-04)

ben: suggest we temporarily reduce batch_size for heavy-traffic model to 512 -> 256 in routing to reduce KV pressure.

dmitri: applied routing override to reduce batch for model rwd/llama-13b-v1 in west2 — monitor.

alice: :thumbsup: looks stable, NVML OOMs down to normal baseline.

carla: leaving handoff notes: if it resurges, escalate to SRE Lead and consider draining entire rack. handoff to next oncall in 30m.

dmitri: adding notes to incident ticket and handing off — monitoring for 20m then will close if quiet.
